title: OML edit operation arguments
description: Common argument shape for outsystems-omleditor write tools (create_service_action, add_dependency, regen_and_write).

omlPath.description: Path to the source .oml file (the module's saved .oml; have the user Ctrl+S in SS first).

outOml.description: Path to write the modified .oml. Use a NEW file (SS locks the source while the module is open); the user reloads this in SS.

name.description: New element name (e.g. service action name). Must be unique across action types in the module.

templateName.description: Existing element to clone (omit to clone the first / build from scratch).
